verdict.rationale: Fastmail has a first-party help article titled "Calendar events and invitations", and a community user refers to "your Fastmail calendar". This points to a native calendar that handles events and invitations, but the pack contains only the title, not the article's content. missing for 10: documentation of viewing the calendar inside the mail interface, responding to invites (accept/decline/RSVP) from within messages, creating events from the email client, and independent hands-on corroboration of an integrated mail-calendar workflow.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can see my calendar, respond to invites, and create events without leaving the email client

citations.quote: you can add your Fastmail calendar to Google Calendar
